        return x / np.sqrt(np.mean(x.astype(np.float64)**2, axis=1, keepdims=True) + 1e-6) * gain

    reconstructed = local_attention_norm(raw)
    reconstruction_error = float(
        np.linalg.norm(reconstructed - observed) /
        max(np.linalg.norm(observed), 1e-12)
    )
    targets = verified_changes(H41[layer])

            np.linalg.norm(proposed, axis=1) * np.linalg.norm(targets, axis=1), 1e-12

        reductions = 1.0 - np.linalg.norm(targets - proposed, axis=1) / np.maximum(
